checks.inconclusive_when: the run failed without an explicit convergence diagnosis, or convergence and task status conflict
checks.not_evaluated_when: no optimize TaskResult, or the result is not an optimize result
checks.subject: geometry_optimization_convergence

checks.inconclusive_when: either result carries no usable coordinates
checks.not_evaluated_when: either TaskResult is absent or of the wrong task kind
checks.refuted_when: atom count, element order or any coordinate differs beyond the frozen tolerance
checks.subject: frequency_geometry_membership
checks.supported_when: symbols/order agree and every Cartesian component differs by <= coordinate_abs_tolerance_angstrom

checks.inconclusive_when: frequencies are absent, the analysis is missing, or normal-mode vectors are absent/incomplete
checks.not_evaluated_when: no frequency TaskResult, or the result is not a frequency result
checks.refuted_when: never (absent evidence is inconclusive, not a contradiction)
checks.subject: hessian_normal_mode_evidence
checks.supported_when: frequencies and parsed normal-mode vectors are present for every non-zero mode with the expected atom count

checks.not_evaluated_when: a method identity is missing or the tasks are wrong
checks.refuted_when: both methods are present and differ
checks.subject: same_method
checks.supported_when: both Provenance.method values are present and equal

checks.inconclusive_when: the state is declared on only one side
checks.not_evaluated_when: neither side declares a state (recorded as a limitation, not a passed check)
checks.refuted_when: both results declare a state and a common identity field differs
checks.subject: same_electronic_state
checks.supported_when: both results declare a state and all common identity fields agree

checks.inconclusive_when: the frequency list cannot be classified
checks.not_evaluated_when: no frequency result or no frequencies
checks.subject: imaginary_mode_count

checks.refuted_when: any sub-check is refuted (an unconverged optimization is always refuted here)
checks.subject: stationary_point_kind
checks.supported_when: convergence, structure membership, Hessian evidence, method consistency and no-imaginary-modes are all supported
